svg.title: Check an image and a moving shot
svg.desc: A short creative brief gives you details you can verify by eye in the result. Describe. Put a blue anchor on the left and a gold bell on the right. Inspect. Compare the objects, colors and positions with your request. Animate. If you make a clip, check whether the pan travels from the anchor to the bell.
